sorte-01.text: Your sat nav goes haywire: go back to Start and collect your salary.

sorte-03.text: Something urgent needs you: hurry to {space}. If you pass Start, collect your salary.

sorte-05.text: Hop on the first ride that comes by: go to the nearest stop.

sorte-06.text: You win the neighbourhood cake contest. Collect 130.

sorte-07.text: The cat knocked over the neighbour's vase. Pay 40.

sorte-08.text: You throw a barbecue and it's on you. Pay 25 to every player.

sorte-09.text: The Wardens stop you for a scooter with no bell. Go to the Barracks.

sorte-10.text: A lawyer friend owes you one. Get out of the Barracks for free (keep this card).

sorte-11.text: The wind blew your roof tiles away. Pay 30 for each house and 90 for each tower.

sorte-12.text: You find a winning ticket in last year's jacket. Collect 60.

quartiere-01.text: The concierge gives back the change you forgot. Collect 110.

quartiere-03.text: It's your birthday! Every player gives you 15.

quartiere-04.text: Refund for a bill you paid twice. Collect 30.

quartiere-05.text: Gym membership you will never use. Pay 90.

quartiere-06.text: You sell your old bike at the flea market. Collect 35.

quartiere-07.text: Off to the seaside! Go back to Start and collect your salary.

quartiere-08.text: You parked on the pavement. Go to the Barracks.

quartiere-09.text: Grandma slips an envelope into your coat. Get out of the Barracks for free (keep this card).

quartiere-10.text: The residents' meeting votes for repairs. Pay 35 for each house and 110 for each tower.

quartiere-11.text: Your dog wins the friendliest pet prize at the fair. Collect 15.

quartiere-12.text: Interest on your savings book comes in. Collect 40.

sorte-13.text: A tourist asks for directions and offers you a lift.
options: Take the lift to the nearest stop
Say no and take the tip: collect 40

sorte-14.text: Fined for loud music after midnight.
options: Argue with the Wardens: go to the Barracks

sorte-15.text: You are offered a small job at the local market.
options: Take the shortcut: move forward 3 spaces

sorte-16.text: Your moped breaks down on a hill. Repairs: pay 110.

quartiere-13.text: Street party: who is paying for the drinks?
options: You are: pay 20 to every player
Call the caterer: pay 70 to the bank

quartiere-14.text: Your neighbour sells you his old scooter cheap.
options: Try it right away: go to Start and collect your salary

quartiere-15.text: The roof is leaking: it needs fixing.
options: Do it yourself: pay 15 for each house and 45 for each tower

quartiere-16.text: You got the recycling wrong all month. Pay 140.
